statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail stays in the low band because the observed reaction to the Warsh keynote is two-way, with a new session low already retraced, while Stress remains elevated on a live front-end rates repricing.
recommendation: Conditions are described as an orderly, two-way equity response to a hawkish rates-first repricing, with the highest conditional risk concentrated in the narrow 14:00Z-16:00Z danger window covering the keynote and any delayed second leg. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote lands hawkish and repricing hits the 2-year, but NQ retraces its new session low and holds mid-range
body:
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00Z and the observed market response is a rates-first repricing that equities have so far absorbed in two-way fashion. Warsh offered no forward guidance, saying he is "committed to a discipline, not to a decision," and framed price stability as the predominant focus with PCE inflation at 3.7% over twelve months and 4.1% over six. He also warned that heavy forward guidance creates a "hall-of-mirrors" problem in which markets and the Fed become mutually blinded to new developments.

The transmission has been concentrated at the front end of the curve. The 2-year yield is 4.32%, about eight basis points higher on the day, while the 10-year is 4.70% and the 30-year is 5.18%, marginally lower. That bear-flattening shape is a genuine hawkish repricing of the near-term policy path rather than a broad duration selloff. The BLS preliminary benchmark revision, released in the same 14:00Z slot, revised payroll employment upward for the first time since 2022, which reinforces the firmer-labour-market reading behind that move.

The equity price path is the reason Tail stays in the low band at 17. NQ futures trade near 29,596.75, down 0.33%. The session range widened after the cash open to 29,506.25-29,707.00, a new low was set, and price has already retraced roughly 90 points back into the middle of that range. A genuine retracement immediately following the week's largest scheduled catalyst is the opposite of the persistent no-retracement structure that Tail measures. The Nasdaq-100 cash index is near 29,551-29,566, down about 0.3% from Thursday's 29,641.56 close, inside a 29,459.30-29,649.05 day range and not holding near either extreme.

Cross-assets are not aligned behind a single directional story. VIX is 14.63, up 0.83% and still near the low end of its recent range. WTI is $82.81 and Brent $87.74, both down about 0.9%, keeping the Iran situation priced as a sanctions and diplomacy question rather than a physical supply threat. The Dow was firmer while the Nasdaq lagged at the open, which reads as rotation rather than broad risk-off, and the single-name damage of the day, Marvell down about 7% after earnings and PayPal down about 13% after the abandoned takeover approach, is idiosyncratic and index-light.

Stress stays elevated at 56 because a live hawkish repricing with rising odds of a rate increase before year-end is a genuinely difficult volatility environment even where the price path remains orderly. The forecast places the peak conditional risk at the 15:00Z hour, where the mapped policy state is WATCH, on the documented pattern in which a rates-first move is followed by a delayed equity second leg. That second leg is a conditional scenario and is not treated as observed. From 16:00Z the conditional path decays on the base case that discovery stays orderly, and from the 21:00Z Globex weekly halt the horizon is a closed market, where a pathological continuous price path has no mechanism, so conditional Tail falls to its weekend floor while Confidence declines with the age of the last live observation.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state throughout, with Tail between 11 and 14 and Stress between 46 and 57. Thursday's late U.S. session carried the Nvidia-driven advance to a 29,641.56 close near the day's high, and the overnight and European hours held a narrow, unwidened futures range with the mode consistently mixed. Stress drifted steadily higher from 46 to 57 through the European morning as the concentrated 14:00Z catalyst stack approached, while Tail stayed pinned in the low band because no persistent one-way structure ever developed. One hour, 10:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon has three phases. The current 14:00Z hour holds the printed keynote and benchmark revision, where the observed reaction is a front-end rates repricing that equities have absorbed with a real retracement. The 15:00Z hour is the conditional peak, the only slot mapped to WATCH, on the possibility of a delayed equity second leg following the rates-first move; from 16:00Z the conditional path decays on the base case of orderly discovery, with a small structural step up at the 19:00Z power hour. From the 21:00Z Globex weekly halt through the end of the horizon the market is closed, conditional Tail sits at its weekend floor because a continuous pathological price path has no mechanism, and Confidence declines with the age of the last live observation.
